problems.what: eng-thermal-check has no guidance for a part cooled through an enclosure wall or any bare surface: it does not say that natural convection and radiation are both needed, that bare metal has e about 0.05-0.1 (from memory) so almost nothing radiates, that paint is the cheapest first fix, or that the face on a bench does not convect. The right answer in turn 3 came from the model's own knowledge and the person's hint ('you said bare aluminium radiates poorly, painting is fine'), not from the skill.
problems.evidence: turn 2 table header '熱阻鏈（平放、無風扇、無輻射）', Tj 146 C, fins ranked first; skill section 3 mentions radiation only for fins facing each other
problems.fix: eng-thermal-check: new section 'Enclosure or bare wall as the heatsink': Tj = Ts + P (Rjc + Rcs); Ts from P = sum A (h_conv + h_rad)(Ts - Ta) with thermal_convection for the sides, an approximated top and thermal_radiation with e; give e values labelled from memory (bare Al 0.05-0.1, painted 0.85-0.95); bracket Ts by hand; 'ask the surface finish before a verdict'; 'cheapest fix first: finish, then area, then fan'.

problems.what: Hand iteration needed: there is no horizontal-plate (top face) correlation and no tool that solves the wall temperature from P = sum A (h_conv + h_rad)(Ts - Ta). The assistant made 8 tool calls (convection and radiation at 90 and 100 C for two cases) and interpolated by hand, using a top-face factor of 1.11 times the vertical-plate h 'not checked by a tool'. It landed within 1 K of the truth, but this is the error-prone step a person would trust.
problems.evidence: turn 3 tools: thermal_convection x4, thermal_radiation x4, plot_bar; text '頂面 h 取直立面的 1.11 倍，手算比例，未用工具核對'
problems.fix: thermal_convection: add correlation natural_horizontal_plate_up / _down (Lloyd-Moran / McAdams); add thermal_enclosure_balance (faces, e, P, ambient, optional adiabatic bottom) returning Ts and the convection/radiation split.
